articles.headline: Semiconductor ETFs Draw Record $7.1 Billion as Investors Buy the AI Chip Dip
articles.summary: U.S. semiconductor ETFs saw record $7.1B inflow on Tuesday, with SOXX attracting $5.4B and leveraged SOXL $1.2B.
articles._summary: U.S. semiconductor exchange-traded funds attracted a record $7.1 billion in fresh capital on Tuesday as investors aggressively bought the dip in artificial intelligence-linked chip stocks. The market commentator said the inflow exceeded the previous daily record by more than 300%, while SOXX has attracted $13.3 billion in net inflows so far this year. Shares have climbed 85.44% year-to-date and 138.28% over the past year.
articles._zh_headline: 投资者逢低买入 AI 芯片，半导体 ETF 吸金创纪录 71 亿美元
articles._zh_summary: 由于投资者大举买入人工智能相关芯片股，美国半导体上市交易基金周二吸引了创纪录的 71 亿美元新资金。该市场评论员表示，流入量超出了此前的单日记录300%以上，而SOXX今年迄今已吸引了133亿美元的净流入。今年迄今，该股股价上涨了 85.44%，去年上涨了 138.28%。

articles.author: Mohd Haider
articles.headline: PMGC Holdings Stock Surges Over 37% Overnight: Why Is It Moving?
articles.summary: PMGC Holdings shares jumped 21.70% after hours after the company disclosed a merger between two wholly owned subsidiaries in an SEC filing.
articles._summary: According to a Thursday Securities and Exchange Commission filing, AGA Precision Systems LLC will merge into A&B Aerospace Inc. , with A&B surviving the Merger as the continuing entity. The agreement was dated Jul. 2. All membership interests in AGA will be canceled without consideration, while A&B’s issued and outstanding shares will remain unaffected. CEO Graydon Bensler signed the filing on PMGC’s behalf. The transaction consolidates two of PMGC’s wholly owned subsidiaries into a single entity.
articles._zh_headline: PMGC Holdings 股价一夜飙升超过 37%：为何如此波动？
articles._zh_summary: 根据周四向美国证券交易委员会提交的文件，AGA Precision Systems LLC 将并入 A&B Aerospace Inc.，A&B 在合并后作为持续实体继续存在。该协议日期为 7 月 2 日。AGA 的所有会员权益将被取消，无需对价，而 A&B 的已发行和流通股将不受影响。首席执行官 Graydon Bensler 代表 PMGC 签署了该文件。该交易将 PMGC 的两家全资子公司合并为一个实体。
